text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — planning a KMS/HSM key rotation + RBAC contraction for private/onprem cluster this Thursday 22:00 UTC. Need netpol preflight, audit pipeline validation, and vuln gating. Dry-run Tue 18:00 UTC. Who can own pieces?

Devon: I can coordinate the cutover orchestration. Clarify: are we rotating the control-plane CMK only, or also rewrapping tenant DEKs?

Ash: Both. Control-plane CMK promotion in our onprem HSM (10.7.12.0/24), then rewrap tenant keys. We will introduce a least-priv service role instead of using admin creds for rotation.

Liam: I'll take netpol staging and conntrack/timeouts. Long-lived agent streams fail silently if egress is too restrictive. Need a staging netpol that allows only required flows.

Maria: Example staging netpol I propose (minimal egress to HSM + DNS + metadata):

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keystore-proxy-egress-hsm-only
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: keystore-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.7.12.0/24   # onprem HSM cluster
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 169.254.169.254/32  # metadata service shim
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-dns: "true"
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53
```

Devon: Add a fallback allow to our internal auth-proxy CIDR for token exchange (10.7.0.0/16) for the rotation window only. Also ensure iptables conntrack timeout for ESTABLISHED remains high enough for multi-minute handshakes.

Ops: FYI — we've triaged a vuln in keystore-agent v1.4.2 (CVE-2026-0007): malformed ASN.1 parsing leads to abort. v1.4.3 includes the fix but changes the handshake wire bytes slightly. If we rotate keys before agents are patched, some rewraps may fail. Plan B required.

Ash: Proposed Plan B if patching lagging: (1) Delay tenant DEK rewraps; (2) Promote new control-plane key in HSM but keep old key active for decrypts (dual active); (3) Enable audit-only enforcement that logs every rewrap/encrypt attempt with principal and key ARN; (4) Deploy agent-side backoff to avoid stampede.

Maria: "Audit-only" — what format and where do we ship these logs? I want per-call structured payloads for forensic timelines.

Ops: We'll emit structured events to audit pipeline with fields: event_type, key_arn, principal, operation, result_code, source_pod. Example: {"event_type":"kms_call","operation":"ReEncrypt","key_arn":"arn:onprem:kms:east:key/rot-2026","principal":"svc:keystore-proxy","result":"OK"}. Route to S3 long-term and to our SIEM for spike detection.

Liam: Also add a smoke test: create a synthetic tenant and run 1200 concurrent short-gen requests for 20m post-cutover. Threshold: decrypt failures <= 0.2% and auth errors <= 0.1%. If exceeded, trigger rollback.

Devon: RBAC change: create a scoped role 'kms-rotation-operator' limited to the new key ARN with only Encrypt/ReEncrypt/GenerateDataKey and no ListKeys or PolicyChange. Short-lived creds (TTL 5m). Manifest example: 

```
role: kms-rotation-operator
principals:
  - svc:control-plane
  - svc:keystore-proxy
perms:
  - kms:Encrypt
  - kms:ReEncrypt
  - kms:GenerateDataKey
scope: arn:onprem:kms:east:key/rot-2026
cred_ttl_seconds: 300
```

Ash: We'll stage the RBAC in staging cluster and exercise the IAM shim that maps svc: names to HSM tokens. Verify token TTL enforcement and that revocation works via the control plane.

sec-bot: SECURITY CHECKLIST: 1) HSM ACLs verified 2) RBAC role staged & tested 3) Netpol preflight + conntrack check 4) Audit forwarding + SIEM rules 5) Canary traffic + smoke tests 6) Runbook + rollback steps 7) NTP preflight for all hosts

Ops: Addendum — NTP: HSM auth requires clock skew < 5s. We'll run an automated NTP check on all agents, bastions, and HSM nodes 1 hour before cutover and fail the job if skew > 2s.

Maria: Rollback criteria suggestion: if decrypt fail rate > 0.5% for 5 consecutive minutes OR keystore-proxy.auth.fail spikes by > 200% vs baseline, revert control-plane key pointer to old key within 3 minutes and revoke temporary rotation creds.

Ops: We'll publish metrics: kms.decrypt.success, kms.decrypt.fail, keystore-proxy.auth.fail, kms.rewrap.latency. Add PagerDuty alerts and link runbook.

Liam: I'll run the netpol impact matrix in staging: TCP/443, DNS, metadata, auth-proxy CIDR. Will validate both IPv4 and IPv6 paths.

Devon: I'll own orchestration and coordinate dry-run. Ash, coordinate agent patch rollout plan and fallback flags. Ops, own audit shipping and alerts. Liam, netpol and smoke tests. Maria, runbook + exec decision.

Maria: Dry-run Tue 18:00 UTC — calendar updated. If anything blocks during cutover ping here and @pagerduty oncall. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/kms-rotation-runbook

Ops: Acknowledged. Publishing staging manifests to https://git.redwood/private/keystore/rotation.

Maria: Thanks all, appreciate the quick alignment. We'll reconvene post dry-run for final sign-off.
